context: Prep note. Dan is buying hosting for a client project. Vendor: Cloudmark Hosting, rep Sam Reed. Needs: uptime of at least 99.95, daily backups kept for 30 days, EU data center. Budget: $400 per month. Current setup: one virtual server with 2 CPUs and nightly backups. Expected traffic: about 40,000 visits per month. The owner must approve any contract.

lines.text: Hi Sam, thanks for the call. Priya is joining as well, I see.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Hi Dan. Yes, Priya is our solutions engineer, she will answer the technical questions.
Great. I will start with what we need, and then you tell me what you can offer.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Sounds good. First, tell me what traffic you expect on the site.
We expect about 40,000 visits a month at the moment.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: And please describe your current setup, so I know where you are coming from.
It is a single virtual server with two CPUs and nightly backups.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Understood. Our standard plan has a 99.9 uptime guarantee and it fits that size well.
We need at least 99.95. What does your guarantee cover?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: For 99.95 you need our business tier. The SLA credits are different there.
And how long do you keep backups, and can I restore a single site?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: We keep backups, yes. Let me tell you about our data centers first, we have three in Europe.
Good, but I still need the backup retention number.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Our support is open 24 hours by phone and chat, with a fast response.
Please put the exact response time in writing in the SLA.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Of course. What would you like to know about the migration itself?
How long is the cutover, and is there downtime?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Usually under an hour, and we do it at night.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I will have Priya send that. Now, the price for the business tier is $520 per month.
That is above our budget of $400. Is there room on the price?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Maybe, if you sign for a year. We do not do month to month on that tier.
A full year is hard for me without a trial. Can we start with three months?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: We could look at a trial with a smaller plan first. I will check with Sam.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Priya, can you check if the Frankfurt data center has space?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Yes, there is space. I just looked.
Okay, thanks.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Also, are you talking to other vendors? Just so I know how to position this.
Yes, I am comparing a few options, but I will not name them.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Fair. What about a CDN? We have a great add-on and I can show you a demo.
Let us park the CDN for now and finish uptime and backups.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Of course. Migration is free, by the way, with a small setup fee of $300.
Which is it, free migration or a $300 setup fee?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: The setup fee is waived for annual customers. Sorry for the confusion.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Did you see the match on Sunday? We were at the stadium.
I only watched the highlights.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: It was amazing. The weather held up too.
Lucky you.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Dan, do you need the migration checklist file?
Yes please, send it with the SLA.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: And what RPO do you need for the database?
A day is acceptable, nightly backups are fine for now.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I will send the SLA and a migration plan by Tuesday.
Good. I can give you an answer by the twentieth.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Great. Do you also need DDoS protection? It is included in the business tier.
Probably yes. Before we finish, what was the answer on backup retention?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Thirty days by default, and ninety days is available as an add-on.
Thirty days works. Thank you both.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Thank you Dan, talk soon.
